ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: paladin
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Paladins channel radiant light. They stand on the front line, shielding allies, healing wounds and burning away anything unholy.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Holy warrior and healer. Smite the wicked, shield the innocent, mend the broken.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: The light does not ask what you are. Only what you will do with it.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: The most durable class and a strong healer. Paladins want Resilience and Potency: Divine Shield, Lay on Hands and Holy Nova keep the whole squad alive.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: templar
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Templars are the sword and shield of the faith: armored, relentless, and impossible to put down.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Charge into the fray clad in light. The unbreakable front line.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: 'Behind me,' said the templar. Everyone obeyed.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: A melee tank. Charge into the enemy, mark them with Judgment and shield the team. Pair with a melee weapon. Wants Resilience and Celerity.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: cleric
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Clerics pour everything into restoration: mass heals, regeneration, sanctuaries, and in the end, true resurrection.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: The greatest healer on the rim. Nobody dies on your watch - or stays dead.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: 'I lost count of how many times she brought me back,' said the old soldier. 'She didn't.'
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Pure support. Keep your colonists alive through anything, regrow lost limbs and resurrect the fallen. Wants Resilience and Focus.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: inquisitor
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Inquisitors hunt what should not exist: rogue mages, abominations and the war machines of fallen empires.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Purge, silence and judge. The scourge of heretic mages and god-machines alike.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: 'We do not ask whether the machine has a soul. We burn it either way.'
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Anti-caster, anti-shield, anti-boss. Dispel buffs, silence mages, banish threats and finish them with Final Judgment. Wants Potency and Resilience.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: zealot
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your weapon strikes mark enemies for judgment.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: radiance
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: You shine. Allies near you constantly heal.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: retribution
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Those who harm you are burned by holy light.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: benediction
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Every holy spell you cast mends allies around you.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: martyr
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: The light will not let you fall. Once every two days, rise from being downed fully healed.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: wrath of heaven
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Light that burns the unnatural: much more holy damage, especially against machines and abominations.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: sanctity
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Become a living sanctuary. Much stronger healing, and every spell wards you.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: exalted
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: When struck, you may erupt in a free Holy Nova.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: holy blade
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Weapon strikes may call down a free Smite on the target.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: juggernaut
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: An unstoppable wall of plate and faith. Huge armor, and melee attackers are punished severely.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: eternal crusade
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: The fight feeds you. Weapon hits restore mana and kills slash your cooldowns.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: triage
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Heals can critically strike for huge amounts.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: lifebinder
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Life flows from you. Allies nearby heal and are cleansed of sickness constantly.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: ascension
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Death is a minor setback. Resurrection and Miracle recharge twice as fast.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: overflowing grace
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Every spell you cast becomes a heal for everyone around you.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: witch hunter
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Holy spells break shields, and you know exactly how to hurt people.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: godslayer
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: The bigger they are, the brighter they burn.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: no heresy
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Holy spells often purge their targets for free and execute the weakened.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: the long inquest
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Final Judgment recharges far faster and calls more pillars.

AbilityDef.label: smite
AbilityDef.description: Call down a lance of light on a single foe.

AbilityDef.label: lay on hands
AbilityDef.description: Heal an ally with a touch of pure light, tending every wound.

AbilityDef.label: divine shield
AbilityDef.description: Become almost untouchable for six seconds.

AbilityDef.label: consecration
AbilityDef.description: Sanctify the ground. Enemies on it burn with holy fire; allies on it slowly heal.

AbilityDef.label: blessing
AbilityDef.description: Bless an ally: tougher armor, steadier nerves and faster healing for hours.

AbilityDef.label: purify
AbilityDef.description: Burn sickness out of a body. Cures infections, diseases, toxic buildup, food poisoning and even drug addictions.

AbilityDef.label: hammer of justice
AbilityDef.description: Hurl a hammer of light that stuns the target.

AbilityDef.label: holy nova
AbilityDef.description: A blast of light: heals allies and burns enemies all around you.

AbilityDef.label: divine intervention
AbilityDef.description: The heavens reach down and hold an ally. For eight seconds nothing can harm them.

AbilityDef.label: heaven's lance
AbilityDef.description: Call a procession of holy pillars that march out from you in a line, searing and judging everything in their path.

AbilityDef.label: sunstrike
AbilityDef.description: Mark the ground. A heartbeat later a column of sunfire slams down: heavy radiant damage, a stagger, and a mark of judgment that shadow magic can detonate.

AbilityDef.label: judgment
AbilityDef.description: A massive smite that marks the target for judgment: everyone hits them harder.

AbilityDef.label: shield of faith
AbilityDef.description: Raise a great ward on yourself and smaller wards on every ally nearby.

AbilityDef.label: holy charge
AbilityDef.description: Charge to a target location in a blaze of light, stunning and knocking back enemies where you land.

AbilityDef.label: righteous fury
AbilityDef.description: Fight with holy fury: your weapon strikes hit harder and heal you.

AbilityDef.label: avatar of light
AbilityDef.description: Become an avatar of the divine for a minute, exploding with holy force as you ascend.

AbilityDef.label: unbreakable vow
AbilityDef.description: Swear to stand your ground. For fifteen seconds you take far less damage and a third of every blow is turned back on the attacker.

AbilityDef.label: greater heal
AbilityDef.description: A powerful heal that can even regrow lost body parts.

AbilityDef.label: mass regeneration
AbilityDef.description: Every ally nearby begins to regenerate rapidly.

AbilityDef.label: resurrection
AbilityDef.description: Bring a dead ally back to life.

AbilityDef.label: sanctuary
AbilityDef.description: Raise a dome of holy light. Allies inside heal quickly and take less damage.

AbilityDef.label: miracle
AbilityDef.description: A true miracle. Resurrects every fallen ally nearby, fully heals and restores every living ally, regrows lost limbs and cures all ills.

AbilityDef.label: greater restoration
AbilityDef.description: A long, exhausting prayer that makes the body whole: every chronic illness cured, every scar erased, every lost limb and organ regrown, every addiction broken.

AbilityDef.label: guardian spirits
AbilityDef.description: Three guardian spirits circle you for forty seconds. Whenever one passes an ally it heals them and lifts poisons and sickness.

AbilityDef.label: purge
AbilityDef.description: Strip away the target's magic: buffs, wards and energy shields are destroyed.

AbilityDef.label: silence
AbilityDef.description: Seal the tongues of everyone in an area. They cannot cast spells for a while.

AbilityDef.label: holy fire
AbilityDef.description: A searing bolt of righteous flame that melts armor and marks the target.

AbilityDef.label: banishment
AbilityDef.description: Hurl a foe far across the battlefield and stun them.

AbilityDef.label: final judgment
AbilityDef.description: Heaven renders its verdict. Twelve pillars of annihilating light fall around the target. Armor means nothing.

AbilityDef.label: mirror of judgment
AbilityDef.description: For ten seconds, every blow struck against you is judged: you take half of it, and the attacker takes all of it.

AbilityDef.label: searing ray
AbilityDef.description: Focus a ray of holy fire on a heretic for four seconds. It burns through armor and brands them for judgment.

HediffDef.label: divine intervention
HediffDef.description: Held in the hand of the divine. Immune to all harm.

HediffDef.label: unbreakable vow
HediffDef.description: Sworn not to fall. Takes 60% less damage and reflects a third of every blow.

HediffDef.label: mirror of judgment
HediffDef.description: Every attack is judged. Takes half damage and reflects the full blow at the attacker.
